title: Paired Rhyme · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Paired Rhyme · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two players and a common word with several rhymes. The pair alternates saying different rhyming words until they have said four. The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Paired Rhyme, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group agrees all four rhyme and none is repeated.
